enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +15: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Druidic Stoneshape: While in Wild Shape, you receive a Primal bonus to PRR equal to half the number of Wilderness Lore feats you have.
Insightful Constitution +6: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Magical Sheltering +37: +37 Enhancement bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
